harness.name: AgentArk SimpleAgent
harness.backend_role: These backends supply model access inside the same AgentArk SimpleAgent evaluation loop. The Codex SDK supplies model access for Astra.
harness.configuration_scope: Actual reasoning effort, output budgets, transport limitations and continuation conditions are reported per model.

session_protocol.context_management: Experience carries across rounds through SimpleAgent's managed context and archives; context compression can summarize earlier interactions. Three rounds belong to one continuing agent session.

video_link_policy: Owner-curated model/attempt associations. Remote videos are not downloaded or hash-verified; recording hashes identify the retained originals, not re-encoded copies on video hosts.
verification_scope: Canvas, metadata, and recommended record bytes were hashed locally. Canvas identity, dimensions, action counts, reference hash, and explicit attempt associations were checked. Video hashes and decode states are retained historical receipts; no new video decode or physical replay is claimed.
privacy: Explicit allowlist only. No local source paths, raw records, native reasoning, API prompts, HTTP payloads, or credentials are included.
media_policy: The reviewed selected PNGs are versioned website assets; records, trajectories and combined model videos are already public. These approvals apply only to the matched source identities and do not authorize new evaluation media or records.

artifacts.history_coverage: last 24 steps per attempt (72/155 actions), not a full 155-action image history

artifacts.scope: Three sequential ICL rounds in one combined video.

artifacts.history_coverage: all 71 recovered logical actions; 26/21/24 per attempt; model-visible API messages and labeled viewer projections

public_artifact_policy: Reviewed public contracts are retained only after the record matches the original source or exact reviewed public copy by hash/size, and round action counts and selected canvas identities match. Original source receipts are preserved separately from sanitized public hashes. Trajectory history coverage is preserved without claiming every history is complete.
